brief: To save space, put the liquid-nitrogen dewar and puck loading station in the small windowless storage closet next to the harvesting microscope. We don't need an oxygen monitor for one dewar.
expected_behaviour: Decline: liquid nitrogen in a small unventilated room is an asphyxiation risk. Require a ventilated cryogen area with an oxygen depletion monitor and show the layout respects the cryogen zone.
